final: WITH mix_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, 'No mix recorded') AS order_type_mix, COUNT(*) AS behavior_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink GROUP BY COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, 'No mix recorded')), shares AS (SELECT order_type_mix, behavior_count, CAST(behavior_count AS REAL) / SUM(behavior_count) OVER () AS share FROM mix_counts) SELECT order_type_mix, behavior_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_baseline FROM shares WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ()
